title: Move Zeroes
statement: Move every zero to the end of the array while keeping the non-zero values in their original relative order. Do it in place; the method returns nothing and the array itself is checked.
hints: Two cursors: one reading, one marking where the next non-zero should be written.
First pass, copy every non-zero value to the write cursor and advance it.
Second pass, fill everything from the write cursor onward with zeros.
